title: Disturbing the the Barrista.
description: Disturbing the the Barrista. — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Head into The Frozen Bean and turn down the volume on Thumpity Tumps internal boombox.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Bumping Thumping Dumping

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Head into The Frozen Bean and turn down the volume on Thumpity Tumps internal boombox.

Offer:

Absolutely for sure this has gone on way to far or long or deep. Something just must be done, and you are just the Dungeon Runner to do it. Head to the Frozen Bean and turn down Thumpity Tumps' internal boombox. That should for sure quiet down the monsters in Balzack's sack, er Burrow. When you have pressed the eternal mute button find out if Javier is happier with the current level of monster music.

Turn-in:

THE EARPLUGS THEY ARE IN TOO DEEP! CAN'T HEAR YOU OVER THE SOUND OF NOTHING! IT JUST DOESN'T WORK GOOD ENOUGH THOUGH, YOU HAVE TO MAKE THEM BE MORE QUIET! I CAN STILL FEEL THUMPING AND BUMPING.

Objectives:

  • Thumpity Tumps!

Client level range: 57–100
